title: Pallet_Subscription MVP (Milestone 1 funding)
body:
# Pallet Subscription (working started) [Updated 30/06/2022] **Like Stripe for Web3** _Subscribers, memberships and secure recurring payments for web3._
_**Link to task**: https://trello.com/c/FCoDZ49M/543-palletsubscription_
**Repo**: https://github.com/kabocha-network/pallet_subscription/tree/master **Network Service Provider:** [Decentration](https://decentration.org)
**Assigned developers**
Engineering supervisor / code reviewer: Timothee([Rusty Crewmates](https://rustycrewmates.com/))
Developer: Simon(RC)
Developer assist: Eljo _(unpaid in this funding proposal)_
Product Manager: Ramsey([Decentration](https://decentration.org)) _(unpaid in this funding proposal)_
## Summary Pallet subscription will be a way for a person, multisig (or supersig) to get recurring payments from a subscribing account on the Edgeware or Kabocha blockchains. Think Patreon, or Netflix or other types of monthly membership services. Pallet_Subscription will enable this functionality.

**Use case:** People can subscribe to your blogging service and pay you monthly in EDG or KAB. The payments will be withdrawn monthly from the subscribers account, automatically.

**Other use cases:** You can make salary payments from a pot of funds (but not from the treasury account). ## Features ![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/661dcc93-3000-4b55-8930-d8eacb7017c4.1655737887512) ## Milestone 1 **Pallet minimal viable version (work already underway)** The first pallet will enable the subscriptions to be taken in EDG (on Edgeware) and KAB (on Kabocha).

Limitations:
The pallet will not have a pricing oracle though this could be included in later editions. **Deliverables**
- Design and build of pallet subscription first version - Substrate node template containing pallet_subscription - Recorded video presentation/workshop of pallet.
